Maya (Finance): Team — Kestrel.ai noticed a burst line on top of their reserved commit for 2026-03-22 09:15-09:25 UTC. Looks like duplicate billing. Can billing confirm?
Omar (Billing): Checking INV-2026-0608. There's an overlapping reserved and burst entry referencing nodepool kestrel-prod-4.
Jules (CS): Kestrel had a planned canary shift that minute. We expected traffic to be absorbed by reserved capacity, not billed as burst.
Ben (Ops): Pulling metering export and router traces now. If the exporter emitted the same meter_id to both buckets, that would explain it.
billing-bot: Auto-detect: overlapping meter_id entries found between reserved_bucket and burst_bucket for INV-2026-0608. Recommend audit.
Maya (Finance): Please attach the metering CSV for kestrel-prod-4 09:00-09:30 UTC. Need an overcharge estimate.
Ben (Ops): Excerpt: ```
2026-03-22T09:15:42Z kestrel-prod-4 reserved_bucket tokens=6,720 meter_id=mi-34cd
2026-03-22T09:15:42Z kestrel-prod-4 burst_bucket tokens=6,720 meter_id=mi-34cd
```
Jules (CS): That meter_id match confirms duplicate-count. Kestrel's AP already reached out. We should offer interim relief.
Nora (AcctMgr): Agreed. What's the estimated overcharge? Maya?
Maya (Finance): Duplicate tokens ~6,720 => ~$52. With rounding/tax propose provisional credit $70 and offer 4 days waived burst as goodwill.
Omar (Billing): I can create a provisional credit memo but need Nora's sign-off. Will tag it provisional_credit and hold final adjustment until Ops finishes the audit.
Nora (AcctMgr): Approved. Please create memo and draft the customer message. Keep wording non-technical: "We've applied a provisional credit and are investigating; final reconciliation in 7 business days."
Ben (Ops): Root cause: exporter dedupe used vm_attach_id which could be reused on retry. Fix deployed 2026-03-23 08:40 UTC (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/2599). Full audit csv uploaded: s3://redwood-billing-audits/2026-03/kestrel-dup-2412345678.csv
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-3702 created: "Kestrel.ai duplicate metering - provisional credit issued" assigned to Omar.
Maya (Finance): Thanks. Omar — confirm when credit applied and update the ticket.
Omar (Billing): Credit memo CM-2026-PROV-303 created and applied to INV-2026-0608 on 2026-03-25. Note: credit_reason=duplicate_meter_attach_retry
Maya (Finance): Confirmed. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
